# 2002 Elections

There were 2 elections held in Jersey in 2002.

- **[Senators General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2002#e2)**

  6 seats · 13 candidates · 45.2% turnout
- **[Deputies General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2002#e3)**

  29 seats (4 uncontested) · 54 candidates · 39.3% average turnout

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

* * *

* * *

## 2002 Senators Election

Election for the role of Senator (6 seats), 16th October 2002.

**[Philip Ozouf Jr](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-ozouf-jr), [Wendy Kinnard](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/wendy-kinnard), [Paul Routier MBE](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/paul-routier), [Mike Vibert](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mike-vibert), [Len Norman](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/len-norman) and [Frank Walker OBE](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/frank-walker) were elected as Senators in 2002.**

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Philip Ozouf Jr](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-ozouf-jr)** |  | 14,442 | 68.6% |
| 2 | **[Wendy Kinnard](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/wendy-kinnard)** |  | 12,230 | 58.1% |
| 3 | **[Paul Routier MBE](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/paul-routier)** |  | 11,687 | 55.5% |
| 4 | **[Mike Vibert](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mike-vibert)** |  | 10,564 | 50.2% |
| 5 | **[Len Norman](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/len-norman)** |  | 10,192 | 48.4% |
| 6 | **[Frank Walker OBE](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/frank-walker)** |  | 9,377 | 44.5% |
| 7 | [Guy de Faye](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/guy-de-faye) |  | 7,576 | 36% |
| 8 | [Terry McDonald](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/terry-mcdonald) |  | 7,488 | 35.6% |
| 9 | [Corrie Stein](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/corrie-stein) |  | 7,303 | 34.7% |
| 10 | [Geraint Jennings](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geraint-jennings) |  | 4,667 | 22.2% |
| 11 | [Chris Whitworth](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/chris-whitworth) |  | 1,982 | 9.4% |
| 12 | [Adrian Walsh](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/adrian-walsh) |  | 1,846 | 8.8% |
| 13 | [Robert Partridge](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/robert-partridge) |  | 1,201 | 5.7% |

21,050 ballots (inc. 37 spoilt papers)
